parameters.name: format
parameters.description: Export file format: xlsx (default) or csv

parameters.name: scope
parameters.description: Which records to export: all (ignores filters, keeps status tab) | filtered (default, honors active filters/search) | current_page (just the page the user is viewing) | selected (requires ids param)

parameters.name: filter[status]
parameters.description: Status tab. Preserved even when scope=all. Values: active | pending | released | partial | cancelled
